{{Quote|Imperial walkers on the North Ridge.|A Rebel controller alerts Echo Base to the presence of AT-AT walkers during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''North Ridge''' was a [[mountain]]ous ridge on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. In [[3 ABY]], the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] was attacked by a [[wampa]] on the ridge, prompting his friend [[Han Solo]] to pass through the region while searching for him. The [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s of [[Blizzard Force]] later ascended the eastern end of the ridge on route to [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] [[Echo Base]], headquarters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Description==
The North Ridge was a lengthy ridge of [[Water|snow]]-covered [[mountain]]s located on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. Its western end sat just south of [[Mount Ison]], with the ridge running east along the southern edge of the [[Lanteel Glacier]] and then ending at the [[Kerane Valley]].<ref name="CL" />

==History==
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] rode his [[tauntaun]] mount off the glacier into the North Ridge while attempting to investigate what he believed to be a [[XJ9-CS14|meteor]]. A [[wampa]] then attacked him on the ridge, knocking him unconscious and then dragged Skywalker and his steed back off the ridge onto the glacier toward its cave. Skywalker's companion [[Han Solo]] later rode out on a tauntaun to search for his missing friend, passing through the ridge before locating him to the north.<ref name="CL" />

When both Skywalker and Solo failed to return to [[Echo Base]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] headquarters on Hoth, the [[T-47 airspeeder]]s of [[Rogue Squadron]] were dispatched to search for the pair. When the [[squadron]] split up, [[Rogue Two]] [[pilot]] [[Zev Senesca]] began flying along the North Ridge from its western end, changing course toward the Lanteel Glacier when he picked up [[sensor]] readings over the ridge.<ref name="CL" />

When the [[Galactic Empire]] later discovered the presence of Echo Base, it deployed the [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s of [[Blizzard Force]] onto the [[Moorsh Moraine]] to the far east of the ridge. The [[walker]]s [[Blizzard 1]] and [[Blizzard 2]] then crossed the Kerane Valley and ascended the North Ridge on a zig-zag path, emerging at the to amidst fog. [[Blizzard 4]], which had unsuccessfully attempted a more easterly route toward Echo Base, then also ascended the North Ridge on a straighter path than the previous walkers.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The North Ridge first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> Artist [[Malcolm Tween]] created the piece "The North Ridge" for the [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|''Star Wars'' Celebration 2020]] art show, which was held online due to the COVID-19 pandemic, in honor of the 40th anniversary of ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Tween had been particularly interested in doing a piece based on Hoth for the occasion, hoping to frame an event on Hoth from a perspective not seen in the film; in the end, he chose Vader's arrival over the North Ridge.<ref name="Celebration 2020 Art">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-2020-art-show-revealed-exclusive|text=''Star Wars'' Celebration 2020 Art Show Revealed - Exclusive}}</ref> While Vader canonically arrives into the Battle of Hoth as the attack is ongoing,<ref name="Invasion of Echo">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=1|story=Tales of Villainy: Invasion of Echo Base}}</ref> Tween envisioned Vader arriving in its aftermath, approaching Echo Base over the North Ridge aboard a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda-''class T-4a shuttle]] under the escort of two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]s. In doing so, the ships pass a downed AT-AT on the ridge.<ref name="Celebration 2020 Art" />
